title: Fumo Gateway configuration (v1)
description: Named upstreams, client credentials, and optional administration. Secrets are read from environment variables, never stored in this file.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL used by editors. Ignored by the gateway; never fetched at runtime.

listen.description: Literal IPv4 or bracketed IPv6 address and port (1–65535), not a hostname. The gateway validates the exact address and port at startup.

admin.description: Override the admin key environment variable. An object requires that variable to be set. When omitted or null, FUMO_ADMIN_KEY still enables administration if set.

clients.description: Client labels mapped to inference bearer-key environment variables. Keys must be nonempty, contain no whitespace/control characters, and differ from each other and the admin key.

upstreams.description: Upstream names become the namespace in model IDs, for example codex/gpt-5.

keyEnv.description: Name of an environment variable containing a secret, not the secret itself. The variable must be set to a nonempty value without whitespace or control characters.

base_url.description: HTTP(S) API root with a host and optional port (1–65535), without userinfo, query, or fragment. Trailing slashes are removed. Exact URL validity is checked at startup.

aliases.description: Local model aliases mapped to nonempty native upstream model IDs. Each request performs one alias lookup.

auth.description: Omit or use null for no authentication. Choose Sign in with ChatGPT or an API key from the environment.

base_url.description: ChatGPT credentials may only be sent to https://api.openai.com/v1.

credentials_dir.description: Private credential directory. Omit or use null for the default state directory. Relative paths are resolved from the working directory.

key_env.description: Not used for ChatGPT authentication; omit this field.

credentials_dir.description: Not used for API-key authentication; omit this field.
